data.name: Eswari
data.long_meaning: Eswari is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Eeshwara', which means 'Lord of the Universe'. This name is believed to be a form of the goddess Lakshmi, who is the deity of wealth and prosperity in Hindu mythology. Eswari is revered for her abundant blessings and is often invoked for financial success and material prosperity.
